idea-plugin.name: Udara Whitelabel
idea-plugin.description:
Browse the whitelabel clients of a Flutter project, inspect their env files, and run or build any client with udara_cli from a tool window in Android Studio or IntelliJ IDEA.
  • Clients tree with app name, bundle id, .env / .env_test keys (secrets masked)
  • Run or debug a client through the Flutter plugin with the usual hot reload and debugger controls
  • Build a specific app version without editing pubspec.yaml
  • Build a client (platform, type, environment) and reveal the artifact
  • Doctor, Clean, Diff, Set up clients, and a Build History table
Requires udara_cli on the PATH or configured under Settings | Tools | Udara Whitelabel.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.1

  • Run Client and the new Debug Client launch through the Flutter plugin: each client gets a normal Flutter run configuration ("Udara: acme") whose Before launch step whitelabels the client, so the standard Run / Debug buttons, hot reload, hot restart, DevTools and breakpoints all work. Falls back to the Run console when the Flutter plugin is not installed.
  • Build Client… takes an optional app version (e.g. 1.4.0 or 1.4.0+12). pubspec.yaml is set for that build only and restored afterwards, even if the IDE is closed mid-build.
  • No longer depends on the Terminal plugin, removing the deprecated and scheduled-for-removal API usages reported for IntelliJ 2026.1 and 2026.2.

0.1.0

  • Initial release: Clients tree with env files, Run / Build / Whitelabel / Doctor / Clean / Diff / Set Up Clients actions, Build History tab.
  • Requires udara_cli 1.2.0 or newer.
